acceptance: The files field of the fix item holds one repo path for each key package
A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it
fix: Convert each key package to its repo path (go/<path below the module>) in keyPackages of go/internal/core/main_red_stop_open.go. Keep one home for the conversion; reuse an existing module-path helper if one exists.

intake_override.reason: the file to change is not on main until PR #1395 lands, so a lane cannot build it

summary: core.OpenMainRedStop (ADR-0165 G4b, PR #1395) files the fix item of a red main. Its files field holds the import path of each key package. Protected-path globs and the overlap check read repo paths, so the field matches nothing. The item is console-routed because go/internal/core is a protected path and the opener is not on main until #1395 lands.
title: The fix item of a red main names repo paths in files, not import paths
